person, reputation or property, or to the person or reputation of any one in whom that person is interested,

bound to do, or to omit to do any act which that person is legally entitled to do, as the means of avoiding 
the execution of such threat, commits criminal intimidation.

threatened is interested, is within this section. …

hurt to any person, or with the knowledge that he is likely thereby to cause hurt to any person, and does 
thereby cause hurt to any person, is said “voluntarily to cause hurt”. 
(2) Whoever, except in the case provided for by sub -section ( 1) of section 122 voluntarily causes 
hurt, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to one year, 
or with fine which may extend to ten thousand rupees, or with both.

what_it_says:
(1) Whoever does any act with the intention of thereby causing 
hurt to any person, or with the knowledge that he is likely thereby to cause hurt to any person, and does 
thereby cause hurt to any person, is said “voluntarily to cause hurt”. 
(2) Whoever, except in the case provided for by sub -section ( 1) of section 122 voluntarily causes 
hurt, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to one year, 
or with fine which may extend to ten thousand rupees, or with both.

what_it_says:
(1) Whoever does any act with the intention of thereby causing 
hurt to any person, or with the knowledge that he is likely thereby to cause hurt to any person, and does 
thereby cause hurt to any person, is said “voluntarily to cause hurt”. 
(2) Whoever, except in the case provided for by sub -section ( 1) of section 122 voluntarily causes 
hurt, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to one year, 
or with fine which may extend to ten thousand rupees, or with both.

conditions: उस व्यक्ति ने ठीक-ठीक क्या कहा? क्या आपको, आपके परिवार को या संपत्ति को नुकसान पहुँचाने की धमकी दी? — आपने हाँ कहा

क्या ऐसा एक बार हुआ या कई बार? — अभी पता नहीं
क्या आपने इसके बारे में पुलिस में शिकायत दी है? — आपने हाँ कहा

what_it_means: ಸರಳವಾಗಿ ಹೇಳಬೇಕಂದ್ರೆ: ನೀವು ಗಂಭೀರ (ಕಾಗ್ನಿಜಬಲ್) ಅಪರಾಧದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ತಿಳಿಸಿದರೂ ಪೊಲೀಸರು ಅದನ್ನು ದಾಖಲಿಸಲು ನಿರಾಕರಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ.

conditions: ನೀವು ಪೊಲೀಸರಿಗೆ ಏನು ದೂರು ಕೊಡೋಕೆ ಹೋಗಿದ್ರಿ? ಕಳ್ಳತನ, ಹಲ್ಲೆ, ಬೆದರಿಕೆ ತರಹದ ಅಪರಾಧನಾ? — ನೀವು ಹೌದು ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ

what_it_says:
(1) Whoever threatens another by any means, with any injury to his 
person, reputation or property, or to the person or reputation of any one in whom that person is interested, 
with intent to cause alarm to that person, or to cause that person to do any act which he is not legally 
bound to do, or to omit to do any act which that person is legally entitled to do, as the means of avoiding 
the execution of such threat, commits criminal intimidation. 
Explanation.—A threat to injure the reputation of any deceased person in whom the person 
threatened is interested, is within this section. …
what_it_means: In simple words: Someone threatened to harm you, your reputation or property to frighten you or force you to do something.
why_it_may_apply: From what you told us: he said this to frighten me into keeping quiet. On 14 April 2026 he threatened that he would break my legs. Nagaraj has threatened me like this many times.
conditions: What exactly did the person say? Did they threaten to harm you, your family or your property? — you said yes

Has this happened only once, or many times? — you said yes
Have you given a complaint to the police about this? — not known yet

conditions: ನೀವು ಪೊಲೀಸರಿಗೆ ಏನು ದೂರು ಕೊಡೋಕೆ ಹೋಗಿದ್ರಿ? ಕಳ್ಳತನ, ಹಲ್ಲೆ, ಬೆದರಿಕೆ ತರಹದ ಅಪರಾಧನಾ? — ನೀವು ಹೌದು ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ
ನೀವು ಹೋದಾಗ ಪೊಲೀಸರು ಏನು ಮಾಡಿದರು? ದೂರು ದಾಖಲಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋಕೆ ನಿರಾಕರಿಸಿದರಾ? — ನೀವು ಹೌದು ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ
ಎಸ್‌ಪಿ ಅವರಿಗೆ ಲಿಖಿತ ದೂರು ಕಳಿಸಿದ್ದೀರಾ ಅಥವಾ ಮ್ಯಾಜಿಸ್ಟ್ರೇಟ್ ಹತ್ತಿರ ಹೋಗಿದ್ದೀರಾ? — ಇನ್ನೂ ಗೊತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ
where_to_verify: Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (2023) ರ ಸೆಕ್ಷನ್ 173 ರ ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಪಠ್ಯವನ್ನು ಇಂಡಿಯಾ ಕೋಡ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ (indiacode.nic.in) ಓದಿ, ಅಥವಾ ಉಚಿತ ಕಾನೂನು ನೆರವಿಗೆ ಜಿಲ್ಲಾ ಕಾನೂನು ಸೇವೆಗಳ ಪ್ರಾಧಿಕಾರವನ್ನು ಸಂಪರ್ಕಿಸಿ. ಇದು ಕಾನೂನು ಸಲಹೆ ಅಲ್ಲ.

what_it_means: आसान शब्दों में: आपने संज्ञेय अपराध की सूचना दी लेकिन पुलिस ने उसे दर्ज करने से मना कर दिया।
why_it_may_apply: आपने जो बताया उसके अनुसार: पुलिस ने मेरी शिकायत लिखने से मना कर दिया और मुझे वापस भेज दिया। 18 अगस्त 2026 को मैं यह शिकायत करने पुलिस स्टेशन गया कि मेरी पड़ोसन भाग्या ने घर में घुसकर सामान चुराया।
conditions: आप पुलिस को क्या बताने गए थे? क्या वो चोरी, मारपीट या धमकी जैसा अपराध था? — आपने हाँ कहा
जब आप गए तो पुलिस ने क्या किया? क्या उन्होंने शिकायत दर्ज करने से मना किया? — आपने हाँ कहा
क्या आपने एसपी को लिखित शिकायत भेजी है या मजिस्ट्रेट के पास गए हैं? — अभी पता नहीं
where_to_verify: Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (2023) की धारा 173 का आधिकारिक पाठ इंडिया कोड (indiacode.nic.in) पर पढ़ें, या मुफ़्त कानूनी सहायता के लिए ज़िला विधिक सेवा प्राधिकरण से संपर्क करें। यह कानूनी सलाह नहीं है।

what_it_says:
If any person, dishonestly or fraudulently, does any act referred to 
in section 43, he shall be punishable with imprisonment for a term which may extend to three years or 
with fine which may extend to five lakh rupees or with both. 
Explanation.–For the purposes of this section,– 
(a) the word “dishonestly” shall have the meaning assigned to it in section 24 of the Indian Penal 
Code (45 of 1860); 
(b) the word “fraudulently” shall have the meaning assigned to it in section 25 of the Indian Penal 
Code (45 of 1860).

punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years and shall

conditions: ನೀವು ಮಾಡದೇ ಇರೋ, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಹೆಸರು ಅಥವಾ ಫೋಟೋ ಬಳಸಿರೋ ಪ್ರೊಫೈಲ್ ಏನಾದರೂ ಇದೆಯಾ? — ನೀವು ಹೌದು ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ
ಆ ಪ್ರೊಫೈಲ್‌ನಿಂದ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಫ್ರೆಂಡ್ಸ್‌ಗೆ ಮೆಸೇಜ್ ಬಂದಿದೆಯಾ ಅಥವಾ ಯಾರಿಗಾದರೂ ದುಡ್ಡು ಕೇಳಿದ್ದಾರಾ? — ಇನ್ನೂ ಗೊತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ
ನಕಲಿ ಪ್ರೊಫೈಲ್ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಆಪ್ ಅಥವಾ ವೆಬ್‌ಸೈಟ್‌ಗೆ ರಿಪೋರ್ಟ್ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದೀರಾ? — ನೀವು ಇಲ್ಲ ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ

what_it_says:
(1) Any man who— 
(i) follows a woman and contacts, or attempts to contact such woman to foster personal 
interaction repeatedly despite a clear indication of disinterest by such woman; or 
(ii) monitors the use by a woman of the internet, e -mail or any other form of electronic 
communication, 
commits the offence of stalking: 
Provided that such conduct shall not amount to stalking if the man who pursued it proves that— 
(i) it was pursued for the purpose of preventing or detecting crime and the man accused of 
stalking had been entrusted with the responsibility of prevention and detection …
what_it_means: In simple words: A man repeatedly contacts or monitors a woman online despite her clearly showing disinterest.
why_it_may_apply: From what you told us: I have clearly told him to stop, but he does not listen. on 5 January 2025 my colleague started messaging me, and keeps doing it every day from new numbers.
conditions: How often does he contact you, and through what — calls, messages, social media? — you said yes

Does he seem to know where you go or what you do online? — not known yet

(a) “transmit” means to electronically send a visual image with the intent that it be viewed by a 
person or persons;

means; …

what_it_says:
Whoever, intentionally or knowingly captures, publishes 
or transmits the image of a private area of any person without his or her consent, under circumstances 
violating the privacy of that person, shall be punished with imprisonment which may extend to three years 
or with fine not exceeding two lakh rupees, or with both. 
Explanation.–For the purposes of this section– 
(a) “transmit” means to electronically send a visual image with the intent that it be viewed by a 
person or persons; 
(b) “capture”, with respect to an image, means to videotape, photograph, film or record by any 
means; …

(1) Any marriage solemnized, whether before or after the commencement of this Act, 
may, on a petition presented by either the husband or the wife, be dissolved by a decree of divorce on the 
ground that the other party— 
[(i) has, after the solemnization of the marriage, had voluntary sexual intercourse with any 
person other than his or her spouse; or 
(ia) has, after the solemnization of the marriage, treated the petitioner with cruelty; or 
(ib) has deserted the petitioner for a continuous period of not less than two years immediately 
preceding the presentation of the petition; or] 
(ii) …
what_it_means: In simple words: Ending a marriage through the family court, either by mutual consent or on a ground such as cruelty or desertion.
why_it_may_apply: From what you told us: We got married in July 2024. On 22 July 2024 my husband left the house, and we have been living separately since then. Amit treats me with cruelty and insults me in front of everyone. Amit also wants a divorce; we both agree to separate.
conditions: When and how did you get married? Was the marriage registered? — you said yes
How does your spouse treat you? Is there cruelty, abuse or humiliation? — you said yes
Does your spouse also want a divorce, or will they oppose it? — you said yes
Are you living together now, or separately? Since when? — you said yes

what_it_says:
Whoever, being 
the husband or the relative of the husband of a woman, subjects such woman to cruelty shall be punished 
with imprisonment for a term which may extend to three years and shall also be liable to fine. 
Explanation.—For the purposes of this section, “cruelty” means— 
(a) any wilful conduct which is of such a nature as is likely to drive the woman to commit suicide 
or to cause grave injury or danger to life, limb or health (whether mental or physi cal) of the woman; 
or 
(b) harassment of the woman where such harassment is with a view to coercing her or any person 
related to …
what_it_means: आसान शब्दों में: एक ही घर में पति या उसके रिश्तेदारों द्वारा महिला के साथ शारीरिक, भावनात्मक, मौखिक या आर्थिक दुर्व्यवहार।
why_it_may_apply: आपने जो बताया उसके अनुसार: 11 जुलाई 2022 को मेरे पति ने मुझे मारा और बाल खींचे। हम जिस घर में रहते हैं वो पवित्रा के नाम पर है।
conditions: आपके पति ने आपके साथ क्या किया है? क्या उन्होंने मारा या किसी तरह चोट पहुँचाई? — अभी पता नहीं

what_it_says:
Whoever, being the 
husband or the relative of the husband of a woman, subjects such woman to cruelty shall be punished 
with imprisonment for a term which may extend to three years and shall also be liable to fine.

what_it_says:
For the purposes of section 85, “cruelty” means— 
(a) any wilful conduct which is of such a nature as is likely to drive the woman to commit suicide 
or to cause grave injury or danger to life, limb or health (whether mental or physical) of the woman; 
or 
(b) harassment of the woman where such harassment is with a view to coercing her or any person 
related to her to meet any unlawful demand for any property or valuable security or is on account of 
failure by her or any person related to her to meet such demand.
what_it_means: In simple words: Demanding dowry, or harassing a married woman to get money or property, is an offence.
why_it_may_apply: From what you told us: because we could not pay, my husband locked me in a room and abused me. three months back Deepa demanded two lakh rupees more as dowry.

what_it_says:
The property of a male Hindu dying intestate 
shall devolve according to the provisions of this Chapter:― 
(a) firstly, upon the heirs, being the relatives specified in class I of the Schedule; 
(b) secondly, if there is no heir of class I, then upon the heirs, being the relatives specif ied in 
class II of the Schedule; 
(c) thirdly, if there is no heir of any of the two classes, then upon the agnates of the deceased; and 
(d) lastly, if there is no agnate, then upon the cognates of the deceased.

conditions: ಗಡಿ ಕಲ್ಲು ಅಥವಾ ಬೇಲಿ ಸರಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆಯಾ? ಯಾರು, ಯಾವಾಗ? — ಇನ್ನೂ ಗೊತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ

what_it_means: ಸರಳವಾಗಿ ಹೇಳಬೇಕಂದ್ರೆ: ಎರಡು ಜಮೀನುಗಳ ಗಡಿ ಎಲ್ಲಿದೆ ಅನ್ನೋ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಪಕ್ಕದವರ ಜೊತೆ ಭಿನ್ನಾಭಿಪ್ರಾಯ; ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿ ಸರ್ಕಾರಿ ಸರ್ವೇ ಮೂಲಕ ಬಗೆಹರಿಯುತ್ತದೆ.
why_it_may_apply: ನೀವು ಹೇಳಿದ ಪ್ರಕಾರ: ಆ ಪಟ್ಟಿ ಜಾಗ ತಮ್ಮದು ಅಂತ ಪಕ್ಕದ ಮನೆಯವರು ವಾದ ಮಾಡ್ತಾರೆ. ಅಕ್ಟೋಬರ್ 17, 2025 ರಂದು ಅವರು ಗಡಿ ಕಲ್ಲುಗಳನ್ನು ಕಿತ್ತು ನನ್ನ ಕಡೆಗೆ ಹಾಕಿದರು.
conditions: ಗಡಿ ಕಲ್ಲು ಅಥವಾ ಬೇಲಿ ಸರಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆಯಾ? ಯಾರು, ಯಾವಾಗ? — ನೀವು ಹೌದು ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ
ನಿಮ್ಮ ಜಮೀನಿನ ಸರ್ವೇ ನಂಬರ್ ಏನು, ಪಹಣಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಸ್ತೀರ್ಣ ಬರೆದಿದೆಯಾ? — ಇನ್ನೂ ಗೊತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ
ಆ ಪಟ್ಟಿ ಜಾಗ ತಮ್ಮದು ಅಂತ ಪಕ್ಕದವರು ವಾದ ಮಾಡ್ತಾರಾ? — ನೀವು ಹೌದು ಅಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ
where_to_verify: Karnataka Land Revenue Act (1964) ರ ಸೆಕ್ಷನ್ TBD-boundary ರ ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಪಠ್ಯವನ್ನು ಇಂಡಿಯಾ ಕೋಡ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ (indiacode.nic.in) ಓದಿ, ಅಥವಾ ಉಚಿತ ಕಾನೂನು ನೆರವಿಗೆ ಜಿಲ್ಲಾ ಕಾನೂನು ಸೇವೆಗಳ ಪ್ರಾಧಿಕಾರವನ್ನು ಸಂಪರ್ಕಿಸಿ. ಇದು ಕಾನೂನು ಸಲಹೆ ಅಲ್ಲ.

ಆ ದಾಖಲೆಯನ್ನು ಎಲ್ಲಾದರೂ ಬಳಸಿದ್ದಾರಾ — ಖಾತಾ, ಪಹಣಿ ಬದಲಾಯಿಸೋಕೆ ಅಥವಾ ಮಾರೋಕೆ? — ಇನ್ನೂ ಗೊತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ
where_to_verify: Specific Relief Act (1963) ರ ಸೆಕ್ಷನ್ 31 ರ ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಪಠ್ಯವನ್ನು ಇಂಡಿಯಾ ಕೋಡ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ (indiacode.nic.in) ಓದಿ, ಅಥವಾ ಉಚಿತ ಕಾನೂನು ನೆರವಿಗೆ ಜಿಲ್ಲಾ ಕಾನೂನು ಸೇವೆಗಳ ಪ್ರಾಧಿಕಾರವನ್ನು ಸಂಪರ್ಕಿಸಿ. ಇದು ಕಾನೂನು ಸಲಹೆ ಅಲ್ಲ.

what_it_says:
(1) Any person against whom a written instrument is void 
or voidable, and who has reasonable apprehension that such instrument, if left outstanding may cause him 
serious injury, may sue to have it adjudged void or voidable; and the court may, in its discretion, so adjudge 
it and order it to be delivered up and cancelled. 
(2) If the instrument has been registered under the Indian Registration Act, 1908 (16 of 1908), the court 
shall also send a copy of its decree to the officer in whose office the instrument has been so registered; and 
such officer shall note on the copy of the instrument …
what_it_means: आसान शब्दों में: किसी ने वसीयत या सेल डीड जैसा जाली दस्तावेज़ बनाकर उसे असली बताकर संपत्ति पर दावा किया।
why_it_may_apply: आपने जो बताया उसके अनुसार: उस पर किए गए दस्तख़त असली नहीं हैं, नकली हैं। 9 फ़रवरी 2026 को मेरे बड़े भाई सुरेश ने एक नकली वसीयत बनवाई कि ज़मीन उनको दी गई थी।
conditions: आपको कौन सा दस्तावेज़ जाली लगता है — वसीयत, सेल डीड, दानपत्र? किसने बनाया? — अभी पता नहीं
क्या उस दस्तावेज़ पर दस्तख़त या अँगूठे का निशान असली है? — आपने हाँ कहा
क्या उस दस्तावेज़ का कहीं इस्तेमाल हुआ है — खाता, आरटीसी बदलवाने या बेचने में? — अभी पता नहीं
where_to_verify: Specific Relief Act (1963) की धारा 31 का आधिकारिक पाठ इंडिया कोड (indiacode.nic.in) पर पढ़ें, या मुफ़्त कानूनी सहायता के लिए ज़िला विधिक सेवा प्राधिकरण से संपर्क करें। यह कानूनी सलाह नहीं है।
